rounds.decision: Keep as an isolated experiment. Forward 100 edge improved but remained above 2%; WB343 d100 did not reliably improve. Screen includes one baseline full-invocation timeout; retain that evidence.
Keep as an isolated experiment. Forward 100 edge improved but remained above 2%; WB343 d100 did not reliably improve. Screen includes one baseline full-invocation timeout; retain that evidence.
Promising screen; pending component constraints and exact matching tests, full40, repeated difficult cases. Not promoted.

Rejected: within2 count fell from 37/39 to 35/39, with total score lower by 4.7736287866906935. Retain independent branch and evidence; keep baseline 858e869. Geometry is promising for difficult groups but should augment candidates without displacing the original DFS trajectory.
Promising isolated parallel-geometry screen; pending full40 and predeclared repeat validation. No promotion.

DLL delay-import structure and runtime verified. Five cases tied; WB343 d100 differed under the known timed-search variability. No quality promotion from this 6-case timing screen; carry accounting change into full paired validation.

Accept as improved quality baseline: within2 count retained at 37/39, mean and worst gaps improve, total score improves by 20.342474790481646. Preserve all per-case regressions. Goal remains active: forward 100 edge and WB343 d100 are still above2; no global optimum claim.
Promising screen only; full paired round42 is required before promotion.
Additional variance evidence for rejected union experiment; all three paired repeats retained.

Do not promote replacement geometry master: main scores and mean gap improve, but WB d100 candidate loses two of three fixed paired repeats and has worse repeat worst gap. Keep f2549cd baseline; test retaining both compact and union masters.

Rejected at screen: extra union master helps some scores but loses WB d100 two of three fixed paired repeats; do not expand validation or promote. Retain f2549cd. Extra concurrency is not a reliable substitute for stronger candidate generation.

Reject compactness ranking estimate: forward:100_edge loses 0.9 points in all three fixed paired repeats despite WB d100 improvement. Keep f2549cd. Separate duplicate-pattern diagnostic confirmed candidate quota waste.

Reject changing both per-shape and group quotas to distinct patterns: 12-case score sum regresses, WB d100 loses two of three paired repeats. Deduplication is confirmed, but quality improvement is unproven. Keep f2549cd; changing per-shape quotas also redistributes search away from later shapes.

Do not promote: preserves per-shape search share and removes duplicates, but no high-gap improvement; WB fixed repeats tie twice and lose 4.6 points once. Inspect baseline stage provenance to target missed gain rather than more geometry quota changes.

Reject all-master VND polishing: no forward hard-case improvement; WB d100 loses two of three fixed repeats, with candidate -607.9007688548882 twice. Existing workers and deadlines retained but extra polishing changes search trajectory and does not stabilize the target gain.

Do not promote 80ms per-group value model: forward hard case unchanged, WB large repeat variability including candidate -608.0481383562276. Isolated group budget diagnostic supports concentrating a longer solve on one priority value-loss group.

Reject single 750ms priority value-pattern solve: forward hard case ties all three repeats, WB loses all three paired repeats. Model component is independently audited, but new candidate uptake/retention and compatible owner-relocation patterns need diagnosis before more quality tuning.
Rejected: forward100 gains reproduce, but several large-case score regressions. Next preserve complete original geometry generation before value repair.

Rejected: forward100 gain reproduced in only two of three fixed repeats; WB d100 candidate loses 0.65 points in all three repeats. Keep f2549cd baseline; investigate generation budget/complement completion before broader validation.
Not promoted: no forward100 improvement; component selection examines only the highest local-score candidate, whose resource owner is expensive to relocate. Next test two ownership-diverse seeds.

Not promoted: ownership diversity gives reproducible forward100 gains, but reverse full edge regresses and WB d100 remains unstable. Next retain the original geometry master and enrich only the existing fallback portfolio path.
Promising focused screen: stable forward100 gains and positive total score change. Advance immutable 03d36a8 binary to complete 40-case paired comparison and fixed six-case repeats before promotion.

Promote immutable 03d36a8 owner-complement implementation: whole-corpus score, fixed-repeat score, within-2 count, mean gap and worst gap improve; all 124 normal invocations complete/legal/parity-consistent/under 5s. Keep archived f2549cd and continue WB d100 optimization.
Supplemental full-stress check passes; contributes evidence to round56 promotion, not an independent acceptance run.

Not promoted: multiple final VND starts give one strong WB d100 gain, but do not meet 2% consistently and main worst gap regresses. Next diversify equal-priority traversal order and expose actual retained/polished start counts.
